description: Semantic class name -> structural role of a plane (rux create classify --role-map). Names match case-insensitively. A class not listed here gives no role; the geometric rules decide. Roles: wall, floor, ceiling, slab, furniture, clutter, unknown. A column is clutter (not a wall; there is no column role yet). Every default annotate prompt (vision/default_prompts.hpp) must be listed; names of older default lists stay listed so projects annotated with them keep their roles.
